modeling_principles: Never model CPI directly — model daily scraped price basket + energy ticks + ZORI, then bridge to CPI for benchmarking.
Never model GDP directly — model electricity consumption + rail velocity + credit-card flows, then reconcile to GDP quarterly.
Government reports are lagging benchmarks, not primary alphas.
Tier 1 and Tier 2 sources are primary nowcast inputs; Tier 3 confirms.
